title: No and erroneous basal rate shown
symptom: During G6 warmup, the loop is stopped to have the DASH deliver basal rate. The main UI shows a line with no rate, and when tapped it says 0.48U/h while the DASH tab says 0.50U/h. Also, there is no basal curve on the graph for almost 2 hours.
fix: The issue was not resolved in the thread; the reporter later said it never happened again and asked to close the issue.
evidence_quote: Not for me. I've never see it happen again. You can close this issue.
